description: A research group is making fabric and plastic using two methods, method A and method B. Method A produces 25 units of fabric and 14 units of plastic per hour. Method B produces 45 units of fabric and 25 units of plastic per hour. Method A requires 60 units of a special element while method B requires 65 units of the same special element. The research group has available 3500 units of the special element and must make at least 1400 units of fabric and 1000 units of plastic. How many of each method should be executed to minimize the total time needed?

NumMethods.definition: The number of production methods available

NumProducts.definition: The number of different products being produced

ProductionRate.definition: Units of each product produced per hour by each method

SpecialElementConsumption.definition: Units of the special element required per hour by each method

TotalSpecialElement.definition: Total units of the special element available

MinRequired.definition: Minimum number of units required for each product

objective.description: "Minimize the total time required to execute methods A and B while meeting the production and resource constraints"

constraints.description: The total special element consumption by method A and method B should not exceed 3500 units
The total fabric produced by method A and method B should be at least 1400 units
The total plastic produced by method A and method B should be at least 1000 units
The number of hours method A and method B are executed must be non-negative
